title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the jazziest late‑1973 Dead, highlighted by a smoking Here Comes Sunshine jam and Keith’s wild Truckin’ outro.
ai_review.review: The leftovers from Dick’s Picks 1 deliver one of the band’s most exploratory performances – a slow‑burn jam that builds into a transcendent Here Comes Sunshine segment with Jerry in top form. The soundboard source is crisp and clear, letting Keith’s outrageous keyboard outro after Truckin’ shine, while the overall energy remains high and jazzy.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star comments praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only minor complaints about ordering, not sound, keep the rating just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as crisp and clear with no noticeable drop‑outs; keyboard detail is especially praised, indicating a high‑fidelity soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The leftovers complete the December 19, 1973 show and maintain a cohesive, jazzy flow; fans note the band’s tight interplay throughout the late‑’73 period.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for transcendent, genius moments in the jam – “pure genius from Jerry” and fully in sync with the band.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned positively in the smooth transition into the McGee segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s outro after Truckin’ described as “ridiculous”, “air‑piano” worthy and a highlight of the performance.
